## D — Driving definitions
Accuracy scope: Driving definitions; each fact block identifies exactly one registered physical source page.
Definitions are handbook usage, not an exhaustive current legal code. The broad immigrant label and ambiguous employment-residency grouping are not silently converted into legal classifications. Garbled off-road quantities and motorcycle registration/operation details are withheld. Clear resident alternatives retain their qualifiers.
The author completed a semantic source-fidelity pass over every drafted fact before submission; the scratch receipts enumerate every fact identifier and verdict. This is same-model work and independent coverage and hallucination review remain pending.
Shared pages contribute noncommercial material only. Unreadable graphics are withheld; no picture-dependent rule has been reconstructed from memory.
Currency warning: applicability of the issuer-linked older edition remains source debt (verify WY-SEC15-FRESH).

corpus_stability.reason: Single issuer-linked edition is staged; this is an operational corpus classification, not a verified update frequency or present legal currency. The current issuer warning is retained as source freshness debt in A and D.

verification_debt.claim_text: The issuer warns printed manual material can be outdated; refresh before asserting present-day legal applicability.
Physical page 92 labels every non-US citizen an immigrant. This broad glossary wording is not adopted as a current legal immigration classification.
The employment and residence branch on physical page 94 has a complex and/or grouping. Its exact eligibility interpretation is withheld rather than loosening conjunctive conditions.

Physical pages 93–94 contain off-road and motorcycle material with duplicated numeral words and a cross-page continuation. No garbled quantities or rider-operation rules are taught in this passenger-car section.
The motorcycle-class and ATV restriction renewal statement on physical page 93 is historical administrative policy and outside the assigned passenger-car operating scope.
